s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive visual field defect with worsening headaches and history of intracerebral hemorrhage
salient_findings: Left occipital intraparenchymal hemorrhage on noncontrast head CT
Left tentorial extra-axial enhancing mass with adjacent parenchymal hemorrhage on contrast-enhanced brain MRI
key_facts: 36-year-old Asian man
4-month history of worsening headaches
Complete right homonymous hemianopia
History of left occipital intracerebral hematoma of unknown cause 2 years earlier
Normal vital signs
Neurologic testing confirmed visual field defect without other focal deficits
Left tentorial extra-axial enhancing mass with adjacent parenchymal hemorrhage on MRI
Intraoperative findings of mass invading falx cerebri and adjacent cortex
Histopathological examination showed spindle cells with branching ectatic vasculature and up to 20 mitoses per ten high-power fields
Immunohistochemical studies showed strong immunoreactivity for CD31, CD99, and Fli-1

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive visual field defect with worsening headaches and history of intracerebral hemorrhage
salient_findings: Left occipital intraparenchymal hemorrhage on noncontrast head CT
Left tentorial extra-axial enhancing mass with adjacent parenchymal hemorrhage on contrast-enhanced brain MRI
key_facts: 36-year-old Asian man
4-month history of worsening headaches
Complete right homonymous hemianopia
History of left occipital intracerebral hematoma of unknown cause 2 years earlier
Normal vital signs
Neurologic testing confirmed visual field defect without other focal deficits
Left tentorial extra-axial enhancing mass with adjacent parenchymal hemorrhage on MRI
Intraoperative findings of mass invading falx cerebri and adjacent cortex
Histopathological examination showed spindle cells with branching ectatic vasculature and up to 20 mitoses per ten high-power fields
Immunohistochemical studies showed strong immunoreactivity for CD31, CD99, and Fli-1

differentials: Chordoid glioma of the third ventricle
Central nervous system primitive neuroectodermal tumor
per_call: Chordoid glioma of the third ventricle
Central nervous system primitive neuroectodermal tumor

shortlist.label: Hemangiopericytoma
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathological examination showed spindle cells with branching ectatic vasculature and strong immunoreactivity for CD31, CD99, and Fli-1

shortlist.label: Solitary fibrous tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Similar histopathological features and immunohistochemical profile

shortlist.label: Meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: Intraoperative findings of mass invading falx cerebri and adjacent cortex, and history of intracerebral hemorrhage

shortlist.label: Cavernous angioma
shortlist.why_kept: Initial MRI suggestion and history of intracerebral hemorrhage

shortlist.label: Angiosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: High mitotic rate and strong immunoreactivity for CD31, although less likely than Hemangiopericytoma

raw.rationale: The patient's histopathological examination showed spindle cells with branching ectatic vasculature and high mitotic activity, and immunohistochemical studies demonstrated strong immunoreactivity for CD31, CD99, and Fli-1, which are characteristic features of hemangiopericytoma.

rejected.label: Solitary fibrous tumor
rejected.why: Lack of strong immunoreactivity for CD34 and Bcl-2, which are typical for solitary fibrous tumors

rejected.label: Meningioma
rejected.why: Intraoperative findings of invasion into the falx cerebri and adjacent cortex, and high mitotic activity are not typical for meningioma

rejected.label: Cavernous angioma
rejected.why: Histopathological examination did not show the characteristic multinodular architecture and hyalinized vessels of cavernous angioma

rejected.label: Angiosarcoma
rejected.why: Although the tumor showed high mitotic activity, the overall histopathological and immunohistochemical features are more consistent with hemangiopericytoma than angiosarcoma
